Vendored foliate-js
====================

THIS FILE IS OURS (not upstream). Keep it when updating.

Source:  https://github.com/johnfactotum/foliate-js
Commit:  78914aef4466eb960965702401634c2cb348e9b1 (main, 2026-09-30)
License: MIT (see LICENSE in this folder)
Vendored libraries inside it keep their own licenses:
  vendor/zip.js  BSD-3-Clause
  vendor/fflate.js  MIT
  vendor/pdfjs  Apache-2.0 (plus Foxit/Liberation font licenses)

What we use (EPUB reflowable only):
  epub.js, epubcfi.js, paginator.js, progress.js, overlayer.js,
  text-walker.js, search.js, tts.js, footnotes.js, vendor/zip.js
  (view.js auto-detects other formats; we never open those, so
  comic-book.js, fb2.js, mobi.js, pdf.js and vendor/pdfjs stay idle.)

We do NOT use it as a submodule on purpose: updates are manual.
To update: download the tarball for the new commit, diff against this
folder, review upstream changes, then replace the folder and update the
commit line above.

Upstream warns the API is unstable with no releases; pin deliberately.
